sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: No Limit to Perfection - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "When your conditioning's solid, it's time to start working on applied skills. For a good fighter, a rifle is an extension of his hands! Grab whichever one you like best and get out there to train."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 50 enemies while using assault rifles

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +25,000 EXP
- +300 Assault Rifles skill points
- 10 GP coins
- 1× Valuables crate (Rare)
